allies.rationale_text: Decomposition strengthens consulting-firms-methodology by turning vague issues into hypothesis-testable parts.
allies.source_quote: breaking it down into manageable parts
allies.affinity_rationale: Core method — 'breaking it down into manageable parts' — decomposition IS the analytical engine of consulting methodology, providing the MECE issue trees and logic frameworks that structure the engagement.
allies.activation_condition: When a complex problem needs to be structured into a MECE issue tree or logic framework before analysis can be distributed across team members and workstreams

allies.rationale_text: Root-cause-analysis strengthens consulting-firms-methodology by keeping diagnosis at the machine level instead of stopping at symptoms.
allies.source_quote: thinking of an organization or system as a machine
allies.affinity_rationale: Diagnostic complement — 'thinking of an organization or system as a machine' — provides the diagnostic lens for identifying what is actually broken, but operates within the consulting framework rather than defining it.
allies.activation_condition: When the consulting engagement requires diagnosing the actual root cause of organizational dysfunction rather than treating symptoms identified in the initial problem framing

antagonists.rationale_text: Confirmation-bias corrupts consulting-firms-methodology when the initial hypothesis becomes politically protected instead of rigorously tested.
antagonists.affinity_rationale: Methodology threat — 'risk of confirmation bias' — causes consulting teams to structure their analysis to confirm the initial hypothesis rather than genuinely testing it through the methodology's analytical rigor.
antagonists.activation_condition: When the consulting team's analysis is being structured to confirm the initial hypothesis rather than using the methodology's rigor to genuinely test whether the hypothesis withstands scrutiny
